database.startup_wasm_failed:
The database system failed to start.

This usually indicates:
1. Another process has the database locked
2. Database files are corrupted
3. Insufficient file system permissions

To fix this:
1. Close any other Nimbalyst windows
2. Restart your computer (clears stale locks)
3. If the problem persists, delete the database folder:
   {{path}}

Nimbalyst will now close.

database.restored_successfully: Your database has been successfully restored from the {{source}} backup.
database.restored: Your database has been restored from the {{source}} backup.
database.restore_failed_fresh: Failed to restore from backup. Starting with a fresh database.
database.recovered_message: The application database was corrupted and has been automatically repaired.
database.ambiguous_message: Cannot tell whether another Nimbalyst is already running.
database.ambiguous_detail:
Nimbalyst found a database lock from a few seconds ago and cannot confirm whether the process holding it (PID {{pid}}, host {{host}}, acquired {{timestamp}}) is still alive. Two scenarios are equally likely:

  1. Another Nimbalyst window is open under a different user account or privilege level. Opening anyway will run two instances against the same database and may corrupt data.

  2. A previous Nimbalyst crashed less than a minute ago and the OS has already reused the original PID for a system process. In this case the lock is safe to clear.

If unsure, choose Cancel and look for another Nimbalyst window before retrying.
database.unlock_failed: Could not clear the database lock.
database.unlock_failed_detail:
Removing the lock file failed: {{error}}

If another Nimbalyst window is open, close it manually before retrying.
database.uncertain_message: Nimbalyst cannot start while the database lock state is uncertain.
database.uncertain_detail: Close any other Nimbalyst windows you have open and try again. If you are sure no other Nimbalyst is running, restart this machine to clear any stale system locks.
database.locked_message: Another instance of Nimbalyst is already running.
database.locked_detail:
The database is locked by another process. Please close the other instance before starting a new one.

Running multiple instances simultaneously can cause data corruption.

database.reset_detail: Your previous AI chat sessions could not be recovered, but your document files are safe.
